items.text: ETR post-Sunday injuries watching: Achane (knee), Jefferson (ankle), Hall (quad), Etienne (ham), Evans (rib), Mayfield (thumb dislocate)+McMillan (knee), Coker (quad), Andrews (hand), Spears (ankle), Bech (broken forearm IR).
items.implication: Multiple high-priority fantasy absences for waivers/ROS; Bech to IR.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs and depth chart risers across affected teams.

items.text: Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to ankle injury (left game).
items.implication: Elite WR1 out rest of day; Addison/others elevated. Monitor severity for ROS.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to Jordan Addison and supporting cast.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off and ruled OUT with rib injury/strain; full eval Monday.
items.implication: WR out; painful injury can linger. SF pass-catchers elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased work for remaining SF WRs/TE.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled OUT with thigh/quad injury (left in 4th after plant/tackle; MRI likely Monday).
items.why: Felt something running then on tackle; ruled out quickly.
items.implication: RB1 absence rest of game + potential multi-week; Allen primary.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled OUT vs Chiefs with knee injury; coach Jeff Hafley: 'does not sound optimistic' / major concern, fear of significant issue.
items.why: Left early; coach postgame pessimistic pending further eval.
items.implication: Major RB1 absence; monitor multi-week risk. ROS downgrade risk.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup carries and receiving work open (Wright also OUT).

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) cleared ACTIVE after positive pregame workout in Rio vs Cowboys; expected limited ~20-30 snaps/pitch count after missing Week 2.
items.why: Pregame workout looked good; Schefter confirmed active.
items.implication: High-end WR2/3 upside even limited; reverse Bateman/Andrews DFS leans.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets return to top Ravens WR despite snap limit.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring strain, doctors view as 3-to-4-week injury; OUT for MNF vs Eagles.
items.implication: Multi-week QB absence; Bagent or backup starts. CHI offense limited.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming; WR/RB usage may shift.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert OUT (sprained MCL), expected to miss a few weeks; not on IR.
items.implication: TE1 out MNF and beyond; Mundt/Ertz elevated but low fantasy. WRs gain targets.
items.opportunity: DeVonta Smith/AJ Brown (if healthy) target share up; TE streamers weak.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive (hip/groin) for SNF vs Broncos; Mims also inactive.
items.implication: WR1 out; Adams and supporting WRs elevated.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams primary; other Rams WRs targets.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers ACTIVE and making 2026 season debut (was Q).
items.why: Cleared for debut after knee issue.
items.implication: Elite TE1 back; immediate fantasy starter.
items.opportunity: High target/route share as primary TE.

items.text: Matthew Berry: Risky but if Zay Flowers active for Ravens he's active for me; start him over Bateman.
items.why: Active confirmation; prefers over Bateman even with pitch-count risk.
items.implication: Start Flowers in fantasy over secondary Ravens options.

items.text: With AD Mitchell (finger) expected inactive, Levitan: Jets WR depth chart 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Pritchett etc; expecting TE Kenyon Sadiq hybrid slot/wide snaps. High opportunity Wilson.
items.why: Mitchell GTD to inactive (team-high 12 targets prior week).
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 with expanded target share; Sadiq hybrid boosts.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets spike; Isaiah Williams cash/DFS flier (Levitan played him).

items.text: ETR/Levitan projected Zay Flowers OUT in initial Week 3 projections due to hamstring and team not counting on him; kept late-swap Bateman/Andrews DFS ready. Flowers later ACTIVE.
items.why: Team tone pessimistic pre-workout; limited practice only Friday.
items.implication: Late swap value; actual limited return still viable.
items.conflict: Projected OUT but played limited and produced (5/6 for 84 + rush).

items.text: ETR Sunday AM GTD/Expected/Q summary: Flowers GTD (not counting); Warren/Pittman/Barkley/Smith/Bowers/Evans/Coker/Coleman expected; Parkinson Q trending right; Spears hopeful.
items.implication: Most key pieces in; Flowers pivot.
items.conflict: Evans later OUT ribs; Flowers flipped ACTIVE.
